zh: CUBE：从定位到量产的产品系统落地
en: CUBE: Product System from Positioning to Mass Production

zh: 把人群定位与产品策略转译为可量产的产品系统，打通从概念到交付的落地链路。
en: Translating audience positioning and product strategy into a mass-producible product system, connecting the full path from concept to delivery.

zh: 把人群定位与产品策略转译为可量产的产品系统，打通从概念到交付的落地链路。
en: Translating audience positioning and product strategy into a mass-producible product system, connecting the full path from concept to delivery.

zh: 这是一个被真正使用的产品。
en: This is a product that is truly used.

zh: 目标用户代际分析
en: Target User Generation Analysis

zh: 用「用户画像研究」的模块化输出，聚焦产品 A 的核心人群结构（Gen Z/Gen Y/Gen X）、消费能力与行为动机，把画像结论转化为产品定位、功能优先级与传播语气的一致依据。
en: Using modular output from 'User Persona Research' to focus on the core audience structure of Product A (Gen Z / Gen Y / Gen X), their spending power and behavioral motivations, and translating persona insights into a unified basis for product positioning, feature prioritization, and communication tone.

zh: 设计并不是从创意开始，而是从边界开始
en: Design doesn't start with creativity, but with boundaries

zh: 用「定位要点卡片」的模块化表达，把产品 A 的品类机会、人群场景（礼赠/女性生活方式/自有流量）与价值主张（更高客单、新客拓展）结构化呈现，方便团队对齐策略与对外讲解。
en: Using modular 'Positioning Key-Point Cards' to structurally present Product A's category opportunities, audience scenarios (gifting / women's lifestyle / owned traffic) and value propositions (higher AOV, new customer acquisition), enabling team alignment and external communication.

zh: 先限定问题，才有解法。
en: Define the problem first, then find the solution.

zh: CMF 主体探索
en: CMF Main Exploration

zh: 用「系列配色矩阵 + 材质肌理对照」的 CMF 概念图，把不同配色 SKU 的气质与层级关系一屏讲清，方便团队快速收敛方向并推进打样与量产落地。
en: Using a 'Color Matrix + Texture Comparison' CMF concept map to clarify the character and hierarchy of different color SKUs at a glance, helping the team quickly converge on direction and advance sampling and mass-production.

zh: 用「打样实拍记录 + 工艺/颜色问题清单 + 调整结论」的模块化跟进，把 CMF 从概念推进到可量产的成品效果，全程盯进度、控质量并加速迭代收敛。
en: Using modular follow-ups of 'Sample Photos + Process/Color Issue Checklist + Adjustment Conclusions' to push CMF from concept to mass-producible finish, tracking progress, controlling quality and accelerating iteration.

zh: CMF 是连接品牌长期规划与产品落地的关键中介
en: CMF is the key intermediary connecting brand long-term planning with product implementation

zh: 它既要服务品牌表达，也必须服从产品功能与制造现实。
en: It must serve brand expression while also conforming to product function and manufacturing reality.

zh: 美学不是目的，是约束下的结果。
en: Aesthetics is not the goal, but the result under constraints.

zh: 用「配件 CMF 打样实拍 + 电镀/喷涂色差校准 + 装配与耐用性验证」的全流程跟进，把配件从方案发散推进到可量产的稳定版本，确保与主机系列一致并满足交付标准。
en: Using a full-process follow-up of 'Accessory CMF Sample Photography + Plating/Spray Color Calibration + Assembly & Durability Verification' to push accessories from exploratory concepts to mass-producible stable versions, ensuring consistency with the main device series and meeting delivery standards.

zh: 用「工厂背板制造过程记录 + 关键工序验收点 + 色差与纹理校准」的模块化跟进，把设计意图落到生产现场并稳定复现，确保每一批次成品的一致性与可控性。
en: Using modular follow-ups of 'Factory Backplate Manufacturing Process Documentation + Key Process Inspection Points + Color & Texture Calibration' to translate design intent onto the production floor with stable reproducibility, ensuring consistency and controllability across every production batch.

zh: 设计决策必须在真实制造条件中被持续校验
en: Design decisions must be continuously validated in real manufacturing conditions

zh: 从物料、配件到工厂样品，设计始终处于反馈回路中。
en: From materials, components to factory samples, design is always in the feedback loop.

zh: 设计不是在图里完成的。
en: Design is not completed in drawings.

zh: 用「超级符号（图形/斜纹/版式骨架）在包装上的重复利用 + 口味色彩区分」的模块化系统，把多口味 SKU 做到一眼能认、批量可扩展，并同步降低包装迭代与上新成本。
en: Using a modular system of 'Super Symbol (graphic / stripe / layout skeleton) reuse on packaging + flavor color differentiation' to make multi-flavor SKUs instantly recognizable and batch-scalable, while simultaneously reducing packaging iteration and new product launch costs.

zh: 设计是一种选择机制。
en: Design is a selection mechanism.

zh: 包装是用户接触品牌的第一个界面
en: Packaging is the user's first interface with the brand

zh: 它不仅承载信息，也影响用户对产品价值的预期。
en: It not only carries information, but also affects users' expectations of product value.

zh: 第一触点，决定第一判断。
en: The first touchpoint determines the first judgment.

zh: 用「挂绳图案系统 + 配饰组合规则 + 材质工艺落地」的周边模块化设计，把产品1的品牌识别延展到日常佩戴与社交场景，形成可量产、可搭售、可持续上新的配件体系。
en: Using a peripheral modular design of 'Lanyard Pattern System + Accessory Combination Rules + Material & Craft Implementation' to extend Product 1's brand identity into daily wear and social scenarios, forming an accessory system that is mass-producible, cross-sellable, and continuously expandable.

zh: 用「一页纸产品信息墙（结构/参数/卖点/兼容性/使用方式）+ 图标化模块」的模块化资料，把产品1的核心价值与销售话术一次性打包，支持渠道培训、客户沟通与终端陈列快速复用。
en: Using a modular 'One-Page Product Info Wall (structure / specs / selling points / compatibility / usage) + Iconized Modules' approach to package Product 1's core value and sales scripts in one go, supporting channel training, client communication, and rapid reuse in retail displays.

zh: 产品终图
en: Product Final Shot

zh: 产品最终效果图展示。
en: Product final rendering showcase.

zh: 把「从策略到产线」的链路跑通：明确人群与场景，固化产品语言与关键规格
en: Running through the chain 「from strategy to production line」: defining audience and scenarios
column4: solidifying product language and key specifications

zh: 并通过「CMF×包装×物料联动」确保各触点一致表达与可持续扩展。
en: Ensuring consistent expression and sustainable expansion across all touchpoints through 「CMF × Packaging × Material Synergy」.

zh: 把「从策略到产线」的链路跑通：明确人群与场景，固化产品语言与关键规格，并通过「CMF×包装×物料联动」确保各触点一致表达与可持续扩展。
en: Running through the chain 「from strategy to production line」: defining audience and scenarios, solidifying product language and key specifications, ensuring consistent expression and sustainable expansion across all touchpoints through 「CMF × Packaging × Material Synergy」.

zh: 烟弹包装
en: Pod Packaging

zh: 设备包装
en: Device Packaging
